capabilities: organize plugins into custom, reorderable groups
enable or disable individual plugins or whole groups
drag plugins to reorder them within a group or assign them to several groups
search plugins by name or ID, including ungrouped ones
open plugin settings, hotkeys, community pages, folders, and uninstall options
extras: Does not work on mobile yet; group management is also available through Obsidian's CLI, with a separate CLI reference.
problem: Obsidian's plugin list is one flat list, so users with many plugins cannot group, find, or toggle them together.
summary: Plugin manager that organizes installed community plugins into custom groups and lets you enable, disable, or reorder them in bulk.
